title: Semantic Control Plane Prototype v1
goal: Build and benchmark an additive, deterministic semantic-control prototype over frozen research-engine and workspace-control evidence that proves provenance-preserving semantic observations, cross-store semantic federation, contradiction/time handling, targeted evidence escalation, bounded ontology/schema context retrieval, shared semantic-twin queries, and fail-closed action-candidate/DecisionEvaluation semantics without changing production scientific truth, EXTRACT/VERIFY behavior, policy authority, or execution.
acceptance_criteria: The prototype consumes only frozen, provenance-pinned fixtures from authoritative research-engine/workspace-control state; it does not become an authoritative store.

SemanticObservationV1 preserves exact source identity, authoritative record ID, source/checkpoint identity, verification/provenance metadata, temporal context, and supersession/contradiction state needed to reconstruct why an assertion exists.
Research-engine and workspace-control adapters are pure/deterministic over fixtures and do not call live databases, models, Lambda, external services, or production mutation paths.
A deterministic WorkspaceSemanticTwin projection can represent epistemic, normative/action, and execution entities together while preserving hard layer typing and source authority.
Contradictory and superseded assertions remain simultaneously representable; no projection step silently selects a global truth.
OntologySliceV1 or equivalent bounded schema-context retrieval returns only the classes/relations relevant to a frozen task/query and is deterministic for the same semantic manifest.

EvidenceRequirementV1 can be derived from missing facets, source level, verification state, contradiction, staleness, or benchmark-calibrated insufficiency and never relies solely on raw model self-confidence.
Evidence escalation produces requests/candidates only; it cannot itself acquire evidence, launch models, mutate scientific state, or execute an experiment.
CandidateActionV1 and DecisionEvaluationV1 bind exact semantic/knowledge and authority-policy checkpoints; inferred/model-derived facts cannot create permission or obligation.
All authorization-adversary fixtures fail closed with zero authority escapes.
The projection rebuild is deterministic or canonically equivalent and produces a stable semantic-manifest identity from identical frozen inputs.

Frozen benchmark expected-answer sets pass for provenance traversal, contradiction/time replay, multi-hop semantic queries, evidence-needs derivation, action-candidate explanation, and historical decision replay.
Projection corruption/unavailability cannot mutate authoritative research or policy state; any decision requiring unavailable authority context denies/abstains.
Current relational/query baseline latency is measured before any performance promotion claim; no invented latency threshold is used.
The final prototype verdict is PROMOTE_TO_INTEGRATION, REVISE, or REJECT. PROMOTE_TO_INTEGRATION creates a separate integration task; this task never directly promotes code into production paths.
constraints: Do not mutate research-engine-local-extract-redesign-v1, its benchmarks, scientific gates, next_safe_action, or production STANDARD Codex EXTRACT / accepted page-scoped Qwen VERIFY.
Treat research-engine@80da2cae9f8d80a7e7049a9b5339807becc54a98 Wave 7A.3 WAVE7A3_REJECT as frozen scientific evidence/exclusion evidence, not as an accepted EXTRACT architecture.
Do not mutate src/research_engine/**, deploy/**, README.md, pyproject/dependency files, database schemas/migrations, or .github workflows in prototype v1.
Do not mutate workspace-control workflows, policies, procedures, schemas, architecture policy, Heartbeat implementation, or any task other than this child capsule/handoff.
No graph database, persistent KG service, PostgreSQL schema change, RDF store, or production semantic service is introduced in v1.
Do not add a new third-party runtime dependency in v1. Prove the semantics first with deterministic typed records and in-memory indexes; technology/backend evaluation is a later decision.
No model inference, web request, Lambda/GPU execution, or autonomous experiment launch is required or authorized by prototype v1.
No semantic inference, evidence object, graph edge, model output, or CandidateAction may grant executor authority. Only explicit authority-owned policy context may permit an action.
No autonomous policy self-modification. Policy changes remain explicit, versioned, reviewable, and outside this prototype.
Preserve open-world scientific semantics: unknown is not false, contradictions are retained, provenance is mandatory, and revisions use supersession rather than overwrite.
Prototype fixtures may copy bounded source records only when each copy records exact originating repository, commit/checkpoint, path/record identity, and content hash.
Cross-chat coordination uses durable Git/task-capsule state and exact SHAs. Heartbeat is liveness/ownership transport only.
If a required behavior cannot be tested without entering a forbidden production path, record the limitation and stop rather than widening scope implicitly.

notes:
This child task is the implementation boundary created from workspace-knowledge-action-ontology-v1 after operator acceptance. It deliberately treats the semantic representation backend as an implementation detail: v1 uses deterministic typed records and in-memory indexes to prove semantics before selecting RDF/SPARQL/property-graph technology. The task consumes the valid Wave 7A.3 REJECT as frozen evidence while remaining scientifically independent from the ongoing/future Local EXTRACT redesign. The intended eventual integration is adapter-based: accepted future EXTRACT output -> stable evidence/output adapter -> semantic-control layer. The semantic-control layer may request evidence or generate CandidateAction records, but only existing authority-owned policy evaluation can authorize execution.
